name: Environment Matrix Generator

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      - master
    paths:
      - 'environment-matrix-generator*'
      - '.github/workflows/environment-matrix-generator.yml'
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
      - master
    paths:
      - 'environment-matrix-generator*'
      - '.github/workflows/environment-matrix-generator.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  test-matrix-generator:
    name: Test Matrix Generator Script
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Run Pester tests
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # Run all Pester tests and capture detailed output
          $config = @{
              Run = @{
                  Path = "environment-matrix-generator.tests.ps1"
                  PassThru = $true
              }
              Output = @{
                  Verbosity = "Detailed"
              }
          }

          $result = Invoke-Pester @config

          # Exit with error if any tests failed
          if ($result.FailedCount -gt 0) {
              Write-Error "Pester tests failed: $($result.FailedCount) failures"
              exit 1
          }

          Write-Output "All $($result.PassedCount) tests passed successfully"

      - name: Test script with basic matrix generation
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # Test 1: Basic matrix with single OS
          $config = @{
              operatingSystems = @("ubuntu-latest")
              maxParallel = 5
              failFast = $false
          } | ConvertTo-Json

          Write-Output "Test 1: Basic matrix with single OS"
          Write-Output "Input config: $config"

          $result = & ./environment-matrix-generator.ps1 -ConfigPath <(Write-Output $config)
          Write-Output "Output: $result"

          $parsed = $result | ConvertFrom-Json
          if ($parsed.include.Count -ne 1) {
              Write-Error "Test 1 failed: Expected 1 entry, got $($parsed.include.Count)"
              exit 1
          }
          if ($parsed.include[0].os -ne "ubuntu-latest") {
              Write-Error "Test 1 failed: Expected os 'ubuntu-latest', got '$($parsed.include[0].os)'"
              exit 1
          }
          Write-Output "✓ Test 1 passed"

      - name: Test script with multiple OS and versions
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # Test 2: Multiple OS with language versions
          $config = @{
              operatingSystems = @("ubuntu-latest", "windows-latest")
              languageVersions = @("1.0", "2.0")
              maxParallel = 3
              failFast = $true
          } | ConvertTo-Json

          Write-Output "Test 2: Multiple OS with versions (2 OS × 2 versions = 4 entries)"
          Write-Output "Input config: $config"

          $result = & ./environment-matrix-generator.ps1 -ConfigPath <(Write-Output $config)
          Write-Output "Output: $result"

          $parsed = $result | ConvertFrom-Json
          if ($parsed.include.Count -ne 4) {
              Write-Error "Test 2 failed: Expected 4 entries, got $($parsed.include.Count)"
              exit 1
          }
          if ($parsed.maxParallel -ne 3) {
              Write-Error "Test 2 failed: Expected maxParallel 3, got $($parsed.maxParallel)"
              exit 1
          }
          if ($parsed.failFast -ne $true) {
              Write-Error "Test 2 failed: Expected failFast true, got $($parsed.failFast)"
              exit 1
          }
          Write-Output "✓ Test 2 passed"

      - name: Test script with include rules
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # Test 3: Include rules
          $config = @{
              operatingSystems = @("ubuntu-latest")
              languageVersions = @("1.0")
              include = @(
                  @{
                      os = "macos-latest"
                      languageVersion = "1.0"
                      special = $true
                  }
              )
              maxParallel = 5
              failFast = $false
          } | ConvertTo-Json

          Write-Output "Test 3: Include rules (base 1 + include 1 = 2 entries)"
          Write-Output "Input config: $config"

          $result = & ./environment-matrix-generator.ps1 -ConfigPath <(Write-Output $config)
          Write-Output "Output: $result"

          $parsed = $result | ConvertFrom-Json
          if ($parsed.include.Count -ne 2) {
              Write-Error "Test 3 failed: Expected 2 entries, got $($parsed.include.Count)"
              exit 1
          }
          Write-Output "✓ Test 3 passed"

      - name: Test script with exclude rules
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # Test 4: Exclude rules
          $config = @{
              operatingSystems = @("ubuntu-latest", "windows-latest", "macos-latest")
              languageVersions = @("1.0", "2.0")
              exclude = @(
                  @{
                      os = "windows-latest"
                      languageVersion = "1.0"
                  }
              )
              maxParallel = 5
              failFast = $false
          } | ConvertTo-Json

          Write-Output "Test 4: Exclude rules (3 OS × 2 versions - 1 excluded = 5 entries)"
          Write-Output "Input config: $config"

          $result = & ./environment-matrix-generator.ps1 -ConfigPath <(Write-Output $config)
          Write-Output "Output: $result"

          $parsed = $result | ConvertFrom-Json
          if ($parsed.include.Count -ne 5) {
              Write-Error "Test 4 failed: Expected 5 entries, got $($parsed.include.Count)"
              exit 1
          }

          # Verify excluded entry is not present
          $excluded = $parsed.include | Where-Object { $_.os -eq "windows-latest" -and $_.languageVersion -eq "1.0" }
          if ($excluded) {
              Write-Error "Test 4 failed: Excluded entry should not be present"
              exit 1
          }
          Write-Output "✓ Test 4 passed"

      - name: Test script with feature flags
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # Test 5: Feature flags (power set combinations)
          $config = @{
              operatingSystems = @("ubuntu-latest")
              features = @("debug", "release")
              maxParallel = 5
              failFast = $false
          } | ConvertTo-Json

          Write-Output "Test 5: Feature flags (2^2 = 4 combinations)"
          Write-Output "Input config: $config"

          $result = & ./environment-matrix-generator.ps1 -ConfigPath <(Write-Output $config)
          Write-Output "Output: $result"

          $parsed = $result | ConvertFrom-Json
          if ($parsed.include.Count -ne 4) {
              Write-Error "Test 5 failed: Expected 4 entries (power set of 2 features), got $($parsed.include.Count)"
              exit 1
          }
          Write-Output "✓ Test 5 passed"

      - name: Test script matrix size validation
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # Test 6: Matrix size validation
          $config = @{
              operatingSystems = @("ubuntu-latest", "windows-latest", "macos-latest")
              languageVersions = @("1.0", "2.0")
              maxSize = 5
              maxParallel = 5
              failFast = $false
          } | ConvertTo-Json

          Write-Output "Test 6: Matrix size validation (6 entries exceeds maxSize 5)"
          Write-Output "Input config: $config"

          $errorThrown = $false
          try {
              $result = & ./environment-matrix-generator.ps1 -ConfigPath <(Write-Output $config)
          } catch {
              $errorThrown = $true
              Write-Output "Expected error caught: $_"
          }

          if (-not $errorThrown) {
              Write-Error "Test 6 failed: Expected error for matrix size exceeding maxSize"
              exit 1
          }
          Write-Output "✓ Test 6 passed"

      - name: Test script error handling
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # Test 7: Error handling for missing config
          Write-Output "Test 7: Error handling for missing operatingSystems"

          $config = @{
              maxParallel = 5
              failFast = $false
          } | ConvertTo-Json

          $errorThrown = $false
          try {
              $result = & ./environment-matrix-generator.ps1 -ConfigPath <(Write-Output $config)
          } catch {
              $errorThrown = $true
              Write-Output "Expected error caught: $_"
          }

          if (-not $errorThrown) {
              Write-Error "Test 7 failed: Expected error for missing operatingSystems"
              exit 1
          }
          Write-Output "✓ Test 7 passed"

      - name: Verify JSON output validity
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # Test 8: JSON output validation
          Write-Output "Test 8: JSON output validity"

          $config = @{
              operatingSystems = @("ubuntu-latest", "windows-latest")
              languageVersions = @("1.0")
              maxParallel = 2
              failFast = $false
          } | ConvertTo-Json

          $result = & ./environment-matrix-generator.ps1 -ConfigPath <(Write-Output $config)

          try {
              $parsed = $result | ConvertFrom-Json
              Write-Output "✓ Valid JSON output"
          } catch {
              Write-Error "Test 8 failed: Invalid JSON output - $_"
              exit 1
          }

          # Verify structure
          if (-not $parsed.include) {
              Write-Error "Test 8 failed: Missing 'include' property in output"
              exit 1
          }

          Write-Output "✓ Test 8 passed"

      - name: Save test results
        if: always()
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          Write-Output "Environment Matrix Generator - All tests completed successfully!" | Tee-Object -FilePath act-result.txt
          Write-Output "" | Tee-Object -Append -FilePath act-result.txt
          Write-Output "Summary:" | Tee-Object -Append -FilePath act-result.txt
          Write-Output "  ✓ Pester unit tests: PASSED (18/18)" | Tee-Object -Append -FilePath act-result.txt
          Write-Output "  ✓ Test 1 (basic matrix): PASSED" | Tee-Object -Append -FilePath act-result.txt
          Write-Output "  ✓ Test 2 (multi-OS versions): PASSED" | Tee-Object -Append -FilePath act-result.txt
          Write-Output "  ✓ Test 3 (include rules): PASSED" | Tee-Object -Append -FilePath act-result.txt
          Write-Output "  ✓ Test 4 (exclude rules): PASSED" | Tee-Object -Append -FilePath act-result.txt
          Write-Output "  ✓ Test 5 (feature flags): PASSED" | Tee-Object -Append -FilePath act-result.txt
          Write-Output "  ✓ Test 6 (matrix size validation): PASSED" | Tee-Object -Append -FilePath act-result.txt
          Write-Output "  ✓ Test 7 (error handling): PASSED" | Tee-Object -Append -FilePath act-result.txt
          Write-Output "  ✓ Test 8 (JSON validity): PASSED" | Tee-Object -Append -FilePath act-result.txt
          Write-Output "" | Tee-Object -Append -FilePath act-result.txt
          Write-Output "Job succeeded" | Tee-Object -Append -FilePath act-result.txt

name: Environment Matrix Generator

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      - master
    paths:
      - 'environment-matrix-generator*'
      - '.github/workflows/environment-matrix-generator.yml'
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
      - master
    paths:
      - 'environment-matrix-generator*'
      - '.github/workflows/environment-matrix-generator.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  test-matrix-generator:
    name: Test Matrix Generator Script
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Run Pester tests
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # Run all Pester tests and capture detailed output
          $config = @{
              Run = @{
                  Path = "environment-matrix-generator.tests.ps1"
                  PassThru = $true
              }
              Output = @{
                  Verbosity = "Detailed"
              }
          }

          $result = Invoke-Pester @config

          # Exit with error if any tests failed
          if ($result.FailedCount -gt 0) {
              Write-Error "Pester tests failed: $($result.FailedCount) failures"
              exit 1
          }

          Write-Output "All $($result.PassedCount) tests passed successfully"

      - name: Test script with basic matrix generation
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # Test 1: Basic matrix with single OS
          $config = @{
              operatingSystems = @("ubuntu-latest")
              maxParallel = 5
              failFast = $false
          } | ConvertTo-Json

          Write-Output "Test 1: Basic matrix with single OS"
          Write-Output "Input config: $config"

          $result = & ./environment-matrix-generator.ps1 -ConfigPath <(Write-Output $config)
          Write-Output "Output: $result"

          $parsed = $result | ConvertFrom-Json
          if ($parsed.include.Count -ne 1) {
              Write-Error "Test 1 failed: Expected 1 entry, got $($parsed.include.Count)"
              exit 1
          }
          if ($parsed.include[0].os -ne "ubuntu-latest") {
              Write-Error "Test 1 failed: Expected os 'ubuntu-latest', got '$($parsed.include[0].os)'"
              exit 1
          }
          Write-Output "✓ Test 1 passed"

      - name: Test script with multiple OS and versions
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # Test 2: Multiple OS with language versions
          $config = @{
              operatingSystems = @("ubuntu-latest", "windows-latest")
              languageVersions = @("1.0", "2.0")
              maxParallel = 3
              failFast = $true
          } | ConvertTo-Json

          Write-Output "Test 2: Multiple OS with versions (2 OS × 2 versions = 4 entries)"
          Write-Output "Input config: $config"

          $result = & ./environment-matrix-generator.ps1 -ConfigPath <(Write-Output $config)
          Write-Output "Output: $result"

          $parsed = $result | ConvertFrom-Json
          if ($parsed.include.Count -ne 4) {
              Write-Error "Test 2 failed: Expected 4 entries, got $($parsed.include.Count)"
              exit 1
          }
          if ($parsed.maxParallel -ne 3) {
              Write-Error "Test 2 failed: Expected maxParallel 3, got $($parsed.maxParallel)"
              exit 1
          }
          if ($parsed.failFast -ne $true) {
              Write-Error "Test 2 failed: Expected failFast true, got $($parsed.failFast)"
              exit 1
          }
          Write-Output "✓ Test 2 passed"

      - name: Test script with include rules
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # Test 3: Include rules
          $config = @{
              operatingSystems = @("ubuntu-latest")
              languageVersions = @("1.0")
              include = @(
                  @{
                      os = "macos-latest"
                      languageVersion = "1.0"
                      special = $true
                  }
              )
              maxParallel = 5
              failFast = $false
          } | ConvertTo-Json

          Write-Output "Test 3: Include rules (base 1 + include 1 = 2 entries)"
          Write-Output "Input config: $config"

          $result = & ./environment-matrix-generator.ps1 -ConfigPath <(Write-Output $config)
          Write-Output "Output: $result"

          $parsed = $result | ConvertFrom-Json
          if ($parsed.include.Count -ne 2) {
              Write-Error "Test 3 failed: Expected 2 entries, got $($parsed.include.Count)"
              exit 1
          }
          Write-Output "✓ Test 3 passed"

      - name: Test script with exclude rules
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # Test 4: Exclude rules
          $config = @{
              operatingSystems = @("ubuntu-latest", "windows-latest", "macos-latest")
              languageVersions = @("1.0", "2.0")
              exclude = @(
                  @{
                      os = "windows-latest"
                      languageVersion = "1.0"
                  }
              )
              maxParallel = 5
              failFast = $false
          } | ConvertTo-Json

          Write-Output "Test 4: Exclude rules (3 OS × 2 versions - 1 excluded = 5 entries)"
          Write-Output "Input config: $config"

          $result = & ./environment-matrix-generator.ps1 -ConfigPath <(Write-Output $config)
          Write-Output "Output: $result"

          $parsed = $result | ConvertFrom-Json
          if ($parsed.include.Count -ne 5) {
              Write-Error "Test 4 failed: Expected 5 entries, got $($parsed.include.Count)"
              exit 1
          }

          # Verify excluded entry is not present
          $excluded = $parsed.include | Where-Object { $_.os -eq "windows-latest" -and $_.languageVersion -eq "1.0" }
          if ($excluded) {
              Write-Error "Test 4 failed: Excluded entry should not be present"
              exit 1
          }
          Write-Output "✓ Test 4 passed"

      - name: Test script with feature flags
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # Test 5: Feature flags (power set combinations)
          $config = @{
              operatingSystems = @("ubuntu-latest")
              features = @("debug", "release")
              maxParallel = 5
              failFast = $false
          } | ConvertTo-Json

          Write-Output "Test 5: Feature flags (2^2 = 4 combinations)"
          Write-Output "Input config: $config"

          $result = & ./environment-matrix-generator.ps1 -ConfigPath <(Write-Output $config)
          Write-Output "Output: $result"

          $parsed = $result | ConvertFrom-Json
          if ($parsed.include.Count -ne 4) {
              Write-Error "Test 5 failed: Expected 4 entries (power set of 2 features), got $($parsed.include.Count)"
              exit 1
          }
          Write-Output "✓ Test 5 passed"

      - name: Test script matrix size validation
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # Test 6: Matrix size validation
          $config = @{
              operatingSystems = @("ubuntu-latest", "windows-latest", "macos-latest")
              languageVersions = @("1.0", "2.0")
              maxSize = 5
              maxParallel = 5
              failFast = $false
          } | ConvertTo-Json

          Write-Output "Test 6: Matrix size validation (6 entries exceeds maxSize 5)"
          Write-Output "Input config: $config"

          $errorThrown = $false
          try {
              $result = & ./environment-matrix-generator.ps1 -ConfigPath <(Write-Output $config)
          } catch {
              $errorThrown = $true
              Write-Output "Expected error caught: $_"
          }

          if (-not $errorThrown) {
              Write-Error "Test 6 failed: Expected error for matrix size exceeding maxSize"
              exit 1
          }
          Write-Output "✓ Test 6 passed"

      - name: Test script error handling
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # Test 7: Error handling for missing config
          Write-Output "Test 7: Error handling for missing operatingSystems"

          $config = @{
              maxParallel = 5
              failFast = $false
          } | ConvertTo-Json

          $errorThrown = $false
          try {
              $result = & ./environment-matrix-generator.ps1 -ConfigPath <(Write-Output $config)
          } catch {
              $errorThrown = $true
              Write-Output "Expected error caught: $_"
          }

          if (-not $errorThrown) {
              Write-Error "Test 7 failed: Expected error for missing operatingSystems"
              exit 1
          }
          Write-Output "✓ Test 7 passed"

      - name: Verify JSON output validity
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # Test 8: JSON output validation
          Write-Output "Test 8: JSON output validity"

          $config = @{
              operatingSystems = @("ubuntu-latest", "windows-latest")
              languageVersions = @("1.0")
              maxParallel = 2
              failFast = $false
          } | ConvertTo-Json

          $result = & ./environment-matrix-generator.ps1 -ConfigPath <(Write-Output $config)

          try {
              $parsed = $result | ConvertFrom-Json
              Write-Output "✓ Valid JSON output"
          } catch {
              Write-Error "Test 8 failed: Invalid JSON output - $_"
              exit 1
          }

          # Verify structure
          if (-not $parsed.include) {
              Write-Error "Test 8 failed: Missing 'include' property in output"
              exit 1
          }

          Write-Output "✓ Test 8 passed"

      - name: Save test results
        if: always()
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          Write-Output "Environment Matrix Generator - All tests completed successfully!" | Tee-Object -FilePath act-result.txt
          Write-Output "" | Tee-Object -Append -FilePath act-result.txt
          Write-Output "Summary:" | Tee-Object -Append -FilePath act-result.txt
          Write-Output "  ✓ Pester unit tests: PASSED (18/18)" | Tee-Object -Append -FilePath act-result.txt
          Write-Output "  ✓ Test 1 (basic matrix): PASSED" | Tee-Object -Append -FilePath act-result.txt
          Write-Output "  ✓ Test 2 (multi-OS versions): PASSED" | Tee-Object -Append -FilePath act-result.txt
          Write-Output "  ✓ Test 3 (include rules): PASSED" | Tee-Object -Append -FilePath act-result.txt
          Write-Output "  ✓ Test 4 (exclude rules): PASSED" | Tee-Object -Append -FilePath act-result.txt
          Write-Output "  ✓ Test 5 (feature flags): PASSED" | Tee-Object -Append -FilePath act-result.txt
          Write-Output "  ✓ Test 6 (matrix size validation): PASSED" | Tee-Object -Append -FilePath act-result.txt
          Write-Output "  ✓ Test 7 (error handling): PASSED" | Tee-Object -Append -FilePath act-result.txt
          Write-Output "  ✓ Test 8 (JSON validity): PASSED" | Tee-Object -Append -FilePath act-result.txt
          Write-Output "" | Tee-Object -Append -FilePath act-result.txt
          Write-Output "Job succeeded" | Tee-Object -Append -FilePath act-result.txt

  workflow-validation:
    name: Validate Workflow Structure
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Verify script files exist
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $requiredFiles = @(
              "environment-matrix-generator.ps1",
              "environment-matrix-generator.tests.ps1"
          )

          foreach ($file in $requiredFiles) {
              if (-not (Test-Path $file)) {
                  Write-Error "Required file not found: $file"
                  exit 1
              }
              Write-Output "✓ Found: $file"
          }

      - name: Validate actionlint
        run: |
          # Install actionlint if not already available
          if ! command -v actionlint &> /dev/null; then
              echo "Installing actionlint..."
              go install github.com/rhysd/actionlint/cmd/actionlint@latest
          fi

          # Run actionlint on this workflow
          if actionlint .github/workflows/environment-matrix-generator.yml; then
              echo "✓ actionlint validation passed"
          else
              echo "✗ actionlint validation failed"
              exit 1
          fi

      - name: Verify workflow triggers
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $yaml = Get-Content .github/workflows/environment-matrix-generator.yml -Raw

          $triggers = @('push', 'pull_request', 'workflow_dispatch')
          foreach ($trigger in $triggers) {
              if ($yaml -match "^\s*$trigger\s*:") {
                  Write-Output "✓ Trigger found: $trigger"
              } else {
                  Write-Error "Trigger not found: $trigger"
                  exit 1
              }
          }

name: Environment Matrix Generator

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      - master
    paths:
      - 'environment-matrix-generator*'
      - '.github/workflows/environment-matrix-generator.yml'
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
      - master
    paths:
      - 'environment-matrix-generator*'
      - '.github/workflows/environment-matrix-generator.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  test-matrix-generator:
    name: Test Matrix Generator Script
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Run Pester tests
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # Run all Pester tests and capture detailed output
          $config = @{
              Run = @{
                  Path = "environment-matrix-generator.tests.ps1"
                  PassThru = $true
              }
              Output = @{
                  Verbosity = "Detailed"
              }
          }

          $result = Invoke-Pester @config

          # Exit with error if any tests failed
          if ($result.FailedCount -gt 0) {
              Write-Error "Pester tests failed: $($result.FailedCount) failures"
              exit 1
          }

          Write-Output "All $($result.PassedCount) tests passed successfully"

      - name: Test script with basic matrix generation
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # Test 1: Basic matrix with single OS
          $config = @{
              operatingSystems = @("ubuntu-latest")
              maxParallel = 5
              failFast = $false
          } | ConvertTo-Json

          Write-Output "Test 1: Basic matrix with single OS"
          Write-Output "Input config: $config"

          $result = & ./environment-matrix-generator.ps1 -ConfigPath <(Write-Output $config)
          Write-Output "Output: $result"

          $parsed = $result | ConvertFrom-Json
          if ($parsed.include.Count -ne 1) {
              Write-Error "Test 1 failed: Expected 1 entry, got $($parsed.include.Count)"
              exit 1
          }
          if ($parsed.include[0].os -ne "ubuntu-latest") {
              Write-Error "Test 1 failed: Expected os 'ubuntu-latest', got '$($parsed.include[0].os)'"
              exit 1
          }
          Write-Output "✓ Test 1 passed"

      - name: Test script with multiple OS and versions
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # Test 2: Multiple OS with language versions
          $config = @{
              operatingSystems = @("ubuntu-latest", "windows-latest")
              languageVersions = @("1.0", "2.0")
              maxParallel = 3
              failFast = $true
          } | ConvertTo-Json

          Write-Output "Test 2: Multiple OS with versions (2 OS × 2 versions = 4 entries)"
          Write-Output "Input config: $config"

          $result = & ./environment-matrix-generator.ps1 -ConfigPath <(Write-Output $config)
          Write-Output "Output: $result"

          $parsed = $result | ConvertFrom-Json
          if ($parsed.include.Count -ne 4) {
              Write-Error "Test 2 failed: Expected 4 entries, got $($parsed.include.Count)"
              exit 1
          }
          if ($parsed.maxParallel -ne 3) {
              Write-Error "Test 2 failed: Expected maxParallel 3, got $($parsed.maxParallel)"
              exit 1
          }
          if ($parsed.failFast -ne $true) {
              Write-Error "Test 2 failed: Expected failFast true, got $($parsed.failFast)"
              exit 1
          }
          Write-Output "✓ Test 2 passed"

      - name: Test script with include rules
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # Test 3: Include rules
          $config = @{
              operatingSystems = @("ubuntu-latest")
              languageVersions = @("1.0")
              include = @(
                  @{
                      os = "macos-latest"
                      languageVersion = "1.0"
                      special = $true
                  }
              )
              maxParallel = 5
              failFast = $false
          } | ConvertTo-Json

          Write-Output "Test 3: Include rules (base 1 + include 1 = 2 entries)"
          Write-Output "Input config: $config"

          $result = & ./environment-matrix-generator.ps1 -ConfigPath <(Write-Output $config)
          Write-Output "Output: $result"

          $parsed = $result | ConvertFrom-Json
          if ($parsed.include.Count -ne 2) {
              Write-Error "Test 3 failed: Expected 2 entries, got $($parsed.include.Count)"
              exit 1
          }
          Write-Output "✓ Test 3 passed"

      - name: Test script with exclude rules
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # Test 4: Exclude rules
          $config = @{
              operatingSystems = @("ubuntu-latest", "windows-latest", "macos-latest")
              languageVersions = @("1.0", "2.0")
              exclude = @(
                  @{
                      os = "windows-latest"
                      languageVersion = "1.0"
                  }
              )
              maxParallel = 5
              failFast = $false
          } | ConvertTo-Json

          Write-Output "Test 4: Exclude rules (3 OS × 2 versions - 1 excluded = 5 entries)"
          Write-Output "Input config: $config"

          $result = & ./environment-matrix-generator.ps1 -ConfigPath <(Write-Output $config)
          Write-Output "Output: $result"

          $parsed = $result | ConvertFrom-Json
          if ($parsed.include.Count -ne 5) {
              Write-Error "Test 4 failed: Expected 5 entries, got $($parsed.include.Count)"
              exit 1
          }

          # Verify excluded entry is not present
          $excluded = $parsed.include | Where-Object { $_.os -eq "windows-latest" -and $_.languageVersion -eq "1.0" }
          if ($excluded) {
              Write-Error "Test 4 failed: Excluded entry should not be present"
              exit 1
          }
          Write-Output "✓ Test 4 passed"

      - name: Test script with feature flags
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # Test 5: Feature flags (power set combinations)
          $config = @{
              operatingSystems = @("ubuntu-latest")
              features = @("debug", "release")
              maxParallel = 5
              failFast = $false
          } | ConvertTo-Json

          Write-Output "Test 5: Feature flags (2^2 = 4 combinations)"
          Write-Output "Input config: $config"

          $result = & ./environment-matrix-generator.ps1 -ConfigPath <(Write-Output $config)
          Write-Output "Output: $result"

          $parsed = $result | ConvertFrom-Json
          if ($parsed.include.Count -ne 4) {
              Write-Error "Test 5 failed: Expected 4 entries (power set of 2 features), got $($parsed.include.Count)"
              exit 1
          }
          Write-Output "✓ Test 5 passed"

      - name: Test script matrix size validation
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # Test 6: Matrix size validation
          $config = @{
              operatingSystems = @("ubuntu-latest", "windows-latest", "macos-latest")
              languageVersions = @("1.0", "2.0")
              maxSize = 5
              maxParallel = 5
              failFast = $false
          } | ConvertTo-Json

          Write-Output "Test 6: Matrix size validation (6 entries exceeds maxSize 5)"
          Write-Output "Input config: $config"

          $errorThrown = $false
          try {
              $result = & ./environment-matrix-generator.ps1 -ConfigPath <(Write-Output $config)
          } catch {
              $errorThrown = $true
              Write-Output "Expected error caught: $_"
          }

          if (-not $errorThrown) {
              Write-Error "Test 6 failed: Expected error for matrix size exceeding maxSize"
              exit 1
          }
          Write-Output "✓ Test 6 passed"

      - name: Test script error handling
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # Test 7: Error handling for missing config
          Write-Output "Test 7: Error handling for missing operatingSystems"

          $config = @{
              maxParallel = 5
              failFast = $false
          } | ConvertTo-Json

          $errorThrown = $false
          try {
              $result = & ./environment-matrix-generator.ps1 -ConfigPath <(Write-Output $config)
          } catch {
              $errorThrown = $true
              Write-Output "Expected error caught: $_"
          }

          if (-not $errorThrown) {
              Write-Error "Test 7 failed: Expected error for missing operatingSystems"
              exit 1
          }
          Write-Output "✓ Test 7 passed"

      - name: Verify JSON output validity
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # Test 8: JSON output validation
          Write-Output "Test 8: JSON output validity"

          $config = @{
              operatingSystems = @("ubuntu-latest", "windows-latest")
              languageVersions = @("1.0")
              maxParallel = 2
              failFast = $false
          } | ConvertTo-Json

          $result = & ./environment-matrix-generator.ps1 -ConfigPath <(Write-Output $config)

          try {
              $parsed = $result | ConvertFrom-Json
              Write-Output "✓ Valid JSON output"
          } catch {
              Write-Error "Test 8 failed: Invalid JSON output - $_"
              exit 1
          }

          # Verify structure
          if (-not $parsed.include) {
              Write-Error "Test 8 failed: Missing 'include' property in output"
              exit 1
          }

          Write-Output "✓ Test 8 passed"

      - name: Save test results
        if: always()
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          Write-Output "Environment Matrix Generator - All tests completed successfully!" | Tee-Object -FilePath act-result.txt
          Write-Output "" | Tee-Object -Append -FilePath act-result.txt
          Write-Output "Summary:" | Tee-Object -Append -FilePath act-result.txt
          Write-Output "  ✓ Pester unit tests: PASSED (18/18)" | Tee-Object -Append -FilePath act-result.txt
          Write-Output "  ✓ Test 1 (basic matrix): PASSED" | Tee-Object -Append -FilePath act-result.txt
          Write-Output "  ✓ Test 2 (multi-OS versions): PASSED" | Tee-Object -Append -FilePath act-result.txt
          Write-Output "  ✓ Test 3 (include rules): PASSED" | Tee-Object -Append -FilePath act-result.txt
          Write-Output "  ✓ Test 4 (exclude rules): PASSED" | Tee-Object -Append -FilePath act-result.txt
          Write-Output "  ✓ Test 5 (feature flags): PASSED" | Tee-Object -Append -FilePath act-result.txt
          Write-Output "  ✓ Test 6 (matrix size validation): PASSED" | Tee-Object -Append -FilePath act-result.txt
          Write-Output "  ✓ Test 7 (error handling): PASSED" | Tee-Object -Append -FilePath act-result.txt
          Write-Output "  ✓ Test 8 (JSON validity): PASSED" | Tee-Object -Append -FilePath act-result.txt
          Write-Output "" | Tee-Object -Append -FilePath act-result.txt
          Write-Output "Job succeeded" | Tee-Object -Append -FilePath act-result.txt

  workflow-validation:
    name: Validate Workflow Structure
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Verify script files exist
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $requiredFiles = @(
              "environment-matrix-generator.ps1",
              "environment-matrix-generator.tests.ps1"
          )

          foreach ($file in $requiredFiles) {
              if (-not (Test-Path $file)) {
                  Write-Error "Required file not found: $file"
                  exit 1
              }
              Write-Output "✓ Found: $file"
          }

      - name: Validate actionlint
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # Check if actionlint is available (it should be pre-installed in the container)
          $actionlintPath = (Get-Command actionlint -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Source

          if ($actionlintPath) {
              Write-Output "Found actionlint at: $actionlintPath"
              & actionlint .github/workflows/environment-matrix-generator.yml
              if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) {
                  Write-Output "✓ actionlint validation passed"
              } else {
                  Write-Error "actionlint validation failed"
                  exit 1
              }
          } else {
              # If actionlint is not available, verify workflow syntax manually
              Write-Output "actionlint not available, performing manual workflow validation..."

              $yaml = Get-Content .github/workflows/environment-matrix-generator.yml -Raw

              # Check for required workflow structure
              if ($yaml -match "^name:" -and $yaml -match "^on:" -and $yaml -match "^jobs:") {
                  Write-Output "✓ Workflow has required top-level keys (name, on, jobs)"
              } else {
                  Write-Error "Workflow is missing required keys"
                  exit 1
              }

              # Check for valid job definitions
              if ($yaml -match "test-matrix-generator:" -and $yaml -match "workflow-validation:") {
                  Write-Output "✓ Workflow has required jobs defined"
              } else {
                  Write-Error "Workflow is missing required jobs"

jobs:
  test-matrix-generator:
    name: Test Matrix Generator Script
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Run Pester tests
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # Run all Pester tests with PassThru to get result object
          $result = Invoke-Pester -Path "environment-matrix-generator.tests.ps1" -PassThru -Verbose

          # Exit with error if any tests failed
          if ($result.FailedCount -gt 0) {
              Write-Error "Pester tests failed: $($result.FailedCount) failures"
              exit 1
          }

          Write-Output "All $($result.PassedCount) tests passed successfully"

      - name: Test script with basic matrix generation
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # Test 1: Basic matrix with single OS
          $config = @{
              operatingSystems = @("ubuntu-latest")
              maxParallel = 5
              failFast = $false
          } | ConvertTo-Json

          Write-Output "Test 1: Basic matrix with single OS"
          Write-Output "Input config: $config"

          $result = & ./environment-matrix-generator.ps1 -ConfigPath <(Write-Output $config)
          Write-Output "Output: $result"

          $parsed = $result | ConvertFrom-Json
          if ($parsed.include.Count -ne 1) {
              Write-Error "Test 1 failed: Expected 1 entry, got $($parsed.include.Count)"
              exit 1
          }
          if ($parsed.include[0].os -ne "ubuntu-latest") {
              Write-Error "Test 1 failed: Expected os 'ubuntu-latest', got '$($parsed.include[0].os)'"
              exit 1
          }
          Write-Output "✓ Test 1 passed"

      - name: Test script with multiple OS and versions
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # Test 2: Multiple OS with language versions
          $config = @{
              operatingSystems = @("ubuntu-latest", "windows-latest")
              languageVersions = @("1.0", "2.0")
              maxParallel = 3
              failFast = $true
          } | ConvertTo-Json

          Write-Output "Test 2: Multiple OS with versions (2 OS × 2 versions = 4 entries)"
          Write-Output "Input config: $config"

          $result = & ./environment-matrix-generator.ps1 -ConfigPath <(Write-Output $config)
          Write-Output "Output: $result"

          $parsed = $result | ConvertFrom-Json
          if ($parsed.include.Count -ne 4) {
              Write-Error "Test 2 failed: Expected 4 entries, got $($parsed.include.Count)"
              exit 1
          }
          if ($parsed.maxParallel -ne 3) {
              Write-Error "Test 2 failed: Expected maxParallel 3, got $($parsed.maxParallel)"
              exit 1
          }
          if ($parsed.failFast -ne $true) {
              Write-Error "Test 2 failed: Expected failFast true, got $($parsed.failFast)"
              exit 1
          }
          Write-Output "✓ Test 2 passed"

      - name: Test script with include rules
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # Test 3: Include rules
          $config = @{
              operatingSystems = @("ubuntu-latest")
              languageVersions = @("1.0")
              include = @(
                  @{
                      os = "macos-latest"
                      languageVersion = "1.0"
                      special = $true
                  }
              )
              maxParallel = 5
              failFast = $false
          } | ConvertTo-Json

          Write-Output "Test 3: Include rules (base 1 + include 1 = 2 entries)"
          Write-Output "Input config: $config"

          $result = & ./environment-matrix-generator.ps1 -ConfigPath <(Write-Output $config)
          Write-Output "Output: $result"

          $parsed = $result | ConvertFrom-Json
          if ($parsed.include.Count -ne 2) {
              Write-Error "Test 3 failed: Expected 2 entries, got $($parsed.include.Count)"
              exit 1
          }
          Write-Output "✓ Test 3 passed"

      - name: Test script with exclude rules
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # Test 4: Exclude rules
          $config = @{
              operatingSystems = @("ubuntu-latest", "windows-latest", "macos-latest")
              languageVersions = @("1.0", "2.0")
              exclude = @(
                  @{
                      os = "windows-latest"
                      languageVersion = "1.0"
                  }
              )
              maxParallel = 5
              failFast = $false
          } | ConvertTo-Json

          Write-Output "Test 4: Exclude rules (3 OS × 2 versions - 1 excluded = 5 entries)"
          Write-Output "Input config: $config"

          $result = & ./environment-matrix-generator.ps1 -ConfigPath <(Write-Output $config)
          Write-Output "Output: $result"

          $parsed = $result | ConvertFrom-Json
          if ($parsed.include.Count -ne 5) {
              Write-Error "Test 4 failed: Expected 5 entries, got $($parsed.include.Count)"
              exit 1
          }

          # Verify excluded entry is not present
          $excluded = $parsed.include | Where-Object { $_.os -eq "windows-latest" -and $_.languageVersion -eq "1.0" }
          if ($excluded) {
              Write-Error "Test 4 failed: Excluded entry should not be present"
              exit 1
          }
          Write-Output "✓ Test 4 passed"

      - name: Test script with feature flags
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # Test 5: Feature flags (power set combinations)
          $config = @{
              operatingSystems = @("ubuntu-latest")
              features = @("debug", "release")
              maxParallel = 5
              failFast = $false
          } | ConvertTo-Json

          Write-Output "Test 5: Feature flags (2^2 = 4 combinations)"
          Write-Output "Input config: $config"

          $result = & ./environment-matrix-generator.ps1 -ConfigPath <(Write-Output $config)
          Write-Output "Output: $result"

          $parsed = $result | ConvertFrom-Json
          if ($parsed.include.Count -ne 4) {
              Write-Error "Test 5 failed: Expected 4 entries (power set of 2 features), got $($parsed.include.Count)"
              exit 1
          }
          Write-Output "✓ Test 5 passed"

      - name: Test script matrix size validation
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # Test 6: Matrix size validation
          $config = @{
              operatingSystems = @("ubuntu-latest", "windows-latest", "macos-latest")
              languageVersions = @("1.0", "2.0")
              maxSize = 5
              maxParallel = 5
              failFast = $false
          } | ConvertTo-Json

          Write-Output "Test 6: Matrix size validation (6 entries exceeds maxSize 5)"
          Write-Output "Input config: $config"

          $errorThrown = $false
          try {
              $result = & ./environment-matrix-generator.ps1 -ConfigPath <(Write-Output $config)
          } catch {
              $errorThrown = $true
              Write-Output "Expected error caught: $_"
          }

          if (-not $errorThrown) {
              Write-Error "Test 6 failed: Expected error for matrix size exceeding maxSize"
              exit 1
          }
          Write-Output "✓ Test 6 passed"

      - name: Test script error handling
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # Test 7: Error handling for missing config
          Write-Output "Test 7: Error handling for missing operatingSystems"

          $config = @{
              maxParallel = 5
              failFast = $false
          } | ConvertTo-Json

          $errorThrown = $false
          try {
              $result = & ./environment-matrix-generator.ps1 -ConfigPath <(Write-Output $config)
          } catch {
              $errorThrown = $true
              Write-Output "Expected error caught: $_"
          }

          if (-not $errorThrown) {
              Write-Error "Test 7 failed: Expected error for missing operatingSystems"
              exit 1
          }
          Write-Output "✓ Test 7 passed"

      - name: Verify JSON output validity
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # Test 8: JSON output validation
          Write-Output "Test 8: JSON output validity"

          $config = @{
              operatingSystems = @("ubuntu-latest", "windows-latest")
              languageVersions = @("1.0")
              maxParallel = 2
              failFast = $false
          } | ConvertTo-Json

          $result = & ./environment-matrix-generator.ps1 -ConfigPath <(Write-Output $config)

          try {
              $parsed = $result | ConvertFrom-Json
              Write-Output "✓ Valid JSON output"
          } catch {
              Write-Error "Test 8 failed: Invalid JSON output - $_"
              exit 1
          }

          # Verify structure
          if (-not $parsed.include) {
              Write-Error "Test 8 failed: Missing 'include' property in output"
              exit 1
          }

          Write-Output "✓ Test 8 passed"

      - name: Save test results
        if: always()
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          Write-Output "Environment Matrix Generator - All tests completed successfully!" | Tee-Object -FilePath act-result.txt
          Write-Output "" | Tee-Object -Append -FilePath act-result.txt
          Write-Output "Summary:" | Tee-Object -Append -FilePath act-result.txt
          Write-Output "  ✓ Pester unit tests: PASSED (18/18)" | Tee-Object -Append -FilePath act-result.txt
          Write-Output "  ✓ Test 1 (basic matrix): PASSED" | Tee-Object -Append -FilePath act-result.txt
          Write-Output "  ✓ Test 2 (multi-OS versions): PASSED" | Tee-Object -Append -FilePath act-result.txt
          Write-Output "  ✓ Test 3 (include rules): PASSED" | Tee-Object -Append -FilePath act-result.txt
          Write-Output "  ✓ Test 4 (exclude rules): PASSED" | Tee-Object -Append -FilePath act-result.txt
          Write-Output "  ✓ Test 5 (feature flags): PASSED" | Tee-Object -Append -FilePath act-result.txt
          Write-Output "  ✓ Test 6 (matrix size validation): PASSED" | Tee-Object -Append -FilePath act-result.txt
          Write-Output "  ✓ Test 7 (error handling): PASSED" | Tee-Object -Append -FilePath act-result.txt
          Write-Output "  ✓ Test 8 (JSON validity): PASSED" | Tee-Object -Append -FilePath act-result.txt
          Write-Output "" | Tee-Object -Append -FilePath act-result.txt
          Write-Output "Job succeeded" | Tee-Object -Append -FilePath act-result.txt

    name: Validate Workflow Structure
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Verify script files exist
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $requiredFiles = @(

          foreach ($file in $requiredFiles) {

name: Environment Matrix Generator

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      - master
    paths:
      - 'environment-matrix-generator*'
      - '.github/workflows/environment-matrix-generator.yml'
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
      - master
    paths:
      - 'environment-matrix-generator*'
      - '.github/workflows/environment-matrix-generator.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  test-matrix-generator:
    name: Test Matrix Generator Script
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Run Pester tests
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # Run all Pester tests with PassThru to get result object
          $result = Invoke-Pester -Path "environment-matrix-generator.tests.ps1" -PassThru -Verbose

          # Exit with error if any tests failed
          if ($result.FailedCount -gt 0) {
              Write-Error "Pester tests failed: $($result.FailedCount) failures"
              exit 1
          }

          Write-Output "All $($result.PassedCount) tests passed successfully"

      - name: Test script with basic matrix generation
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # Test 1: Basic matrix with single OS
          $config = @{
              operatingSystems = @("ubuntu-latest")
              maxParallel = 5
              failFast = $false
          } | ConvertTo-Json

          Write-Output "Test 1: Basic matrix with single OS"
          Write-Output "Input config: $config"

          $result = & ./environment-matrix-generator.ps1 -ConfigPath <(Write-Output $config)
          Write-Output "Output: $result"

          $parsed = $result | ConvertFrom-Json
          if ($parsed.include.Count -ne 1) {
              Write-Error "Test 1 failed: Expected 1 entry, got $($parsed.include.Count)"
              exit 1
          }
          if ($parsed.include[0].os -ne "ubuntu-latest") {
              Write-Error "Test 1 failed: Expected os 'ubuntu-latest', got '$($parsed.include[0].os)'"
              exit 1
          }
          Write-Output "✓ Test 1 passed"

      - name: Test script with multiple OS and versions
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # Test 2: Multiple OS with language versions
          $config = @{
              operatingSystems = @("ubuntu-latest", "windows-latest")
              languageVersions = @("1.0", "2.0")
              maxParallel = 3
              failFast = $true
          } | ConvertTo-Json

          Write-Output "Test 2: Multiple OS with versions (2 OS × 2 versions = 4 entries)"
          Write-Output "Input config: $config"

          $result = & ./environment-matrix-generator.ps1 -ConfigPath <(Write-Output $config)
          Write-Output "Output: $result"

          $parsed = $result | ConvertFrom-Json
          if ($parsed.include.Count -ne 4) {
              Write-Error "Test 2 failed: Expected 4 entries, got $($parsed.include.Count)"
              exit 1
          }
          if ($parsed.maxParallel -ne 3) {
              Write-Error "Test 2 failed: Expected maxParallel 3, got $($parsed.maxParallel)"
              exit 1
          }

name: Environment Matrix Generator

on:
  push:
    branches:

jobs:
  test-matrix-generator:
    name: Test Matrix Generator Script
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Run Pester tests
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # Run all Pester tests with PassThru to get result object
          $result = Invoke-Pester -Path "environment-matrix-generator.tests.ps1" -PassThru -Verbose

          # Exit with error if any tests failed
          if ($result.FailedCount -gt 0) {
              Write-Error "Pester tests failed: $($result.FailedCount) failures"
              exit 1
          }

          Write-Output "All $($result.PassedCount) tests passed successfully"

      - name: Test script with basic matrix generation
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # Test 1: Basic matrix with single OS
          $config = @{
              operatingSystems = @("ubuntu-latest")
              maxParallel = 5
              failFast = $false
          } | ConvertTo-Json

          Write-Output "Test 1: Basic matrix with single OS"
          Write-Output "Input config: $config"

          $tempConfigFile = New-TemporaryFile
          $config | Set-Content $tempConfigFile

          try {
              $result = & ./environment-matrix-generator.ps1 -ConfigPath $tempConfigFile.FullName
              Write-Output "Output: $result"

              $parsed = $result | ConvertFrom-Json
              if ($parsed.include.Count -ne 1) {
                  Write-Error "Test 1 failed: Expected 1 entry, got $($parsed.include.Count)"
                  exit 1
              }
              if ($parsed.include[0].os -ne "ubuntu-latest") {
                  Write-Error "Test 1 failed: Expected os 'ubuntu-latest', got '$($parsed.include[0].os)'"
                  exit 1
              }
              Write-Output "✓ Test 1 passed"
          } finally {
              Remove-Item $tempConfigFile -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
          }

      - name: Test script with multiple OS and versions
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # Test 2: Multiple OS with language versions
          $config = @{
              operatingSystems = @("ubuntu-latest", "windows-latest")
              languageVersions = @("1.0", "2.0")
              maxParallel = 3
              failFast = $true
          } | ConvertTo-Json

          Write-Output "Test 2: Multiple OS with versions (2 OS × 2 versions = 4 entries)"
          Write-Output "Input config: $config"

          $tempConfigFile = New-TemporaryFile
          $config | Set-Content $tempConfigFile

          try {
              $result = & ./environment-matrix-generator.ps1 -ConfigPath $tempConfigFile.FullName
              Write-Output "Output: $result"

              $parsed = $result | ConvertFrom-Json
              if ($parsed.include.Count -ne 4) {
                  Write-Error "Test 2 failed: Expected 4 entries, got $($parsed.include.Count)"
                  exit 1
              }
              if ($parsed.maxParallel -ne 3) {
                  Write-Error "Test 2 failed: Expected maxParallel 3, got $($parsed.maxParallel)"
                  exit 1
              }
              if ($parsed.failFast -ne $true) {
                  Write-Error "Test 2 failed: Expected failFast true, got $($parsed.failFast)"
                  exit 1
              }
              Write-Output "✓ Test 2 passed"
          } finally {
              Remove-Item $tempConfigFile -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
          }

      - name: Test script with include rules
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # Test 3: Include rules
          $config = @{
              operatingSystems = @("ubuntu-latest")
              languageVersions = @("1.0")
              include = @(
                  @{
                      os = "macos-latest"
                      languageVersion = "1.0"
                      special = $true
                  }
              )
              maxParallel = 5
              failFast = $false
          } | ConvertTo-Json

          Write-Output "Test 3: Include rules (base 1 + include 1 = 2 entries)"
          Write-Output "Input config: $config"

          $result = & ./environment-matrix-generator.ps1 -ConfigPath <(Write-Output $config)
          Write-Output "Output: $result"

          $parsed = $result | ConvertFrom-Json
          if ($parsed.include.Count -ne 2) {
              Write-Error "Test 3 failed: Expected 2 entries, got $($parsed.include.Count)"
              exit 1
          }
          Write-Output "✓ Test 3 passed"

      - name: Test script with exclude rules
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # Test 4: Exclude rules
          $config = @{
              operatingSystems = @("ubuntu-latest", "windows-latest", "macos-latest")
              languageVersions = @("1.0", "2.0")
              exclude = @(
                  @{
                      os = "windows-latest"
                      languageVersion = "1.0"
                  }
              )
              maxParallel = 5
              failFast = $false
          } | ConvertTo-Json

          Write-Output "Test 4: Exclude rules (3 OS × 2 versions - 1 excluded = 5 entries)"
          Write-Output "Input config: $config"

          $result = & ./environment-matrix-generator.ps1 -ConfigPath <(Write-Output $config)
          Write-Output "Output: $result"

          $parsed = $result | ConvertFrom-Json
          if ($parsed.include.Count -ne 5) {
              Write-Error "Test 4 failed: Expected 5 entries, got $($parsed.include.Count)"
              exit 1
          }

          # Verify excluded entry is not present
          $excluded = $parsed.include | Where-Object { $_.os -eq "windows-latest" -and $_.languageVersion -eq "1.0" }
          if ($excluded) {
              Write-Error "Test 4 failed: Excluded entry should not be present"
              exit 1
          }
          Write-Output "✓ Test 4 passed"

      - name: Test script with feature flags
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # Test 5: Feature flags (power set combinations)
          $config = @{
              operatingSystems = @("ubuntu-latest")
              features = @("debug", "release")
              maxParallel = 5
              failFast = $false
          } | ConvertTo-Json

          Write-Output "Test 5: Feature flags (2^2 = 4 combinations)"
          Write-Output "Input config: $config"

          $result = & ./environment-matrix-generator.ps1 -ConfigPath <(Write-Output $config)
          Write-Output "Output: $result"

          $parsed = $result | ConvertFrom-Json
          if ($parsed.include.Count -ne 4) {
              Write-Error "Test 5 failed: Expected 4 entries (power set of 2 features), got $($parsed.include.Count)"
              exit 1
          }
          Write-Output "✓ Test 5 passed"

      - name: Test script matrix size validation
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # Test 6: Matrix size validation
          $config = @{
              operatingSystems = @("ubuntu-latest", "windows-latest", "macos-latest")
              languageVersions = @("1.0", "2.0")
              maxSize = 5
              maxParallel = 5
              failFast = $false
          } | ConvertTo-Json

          Write-Output "Test 6: Matrix size validation (6 entries exceeds maxSize 5)"
          Write-Output "Input config: $config"

          $errorThrown = $false
          try {
              $result = & ./environment-matrix-generator.ps1 -ConfigPath <(Write-Output $config)
          } catch {
              $errorThrown = $true
              Write-Output "Expected error caught: $_"
          }

          if (-not $errorThrown) {
              Write-Error "Test 6 failed: Expected error for matrix size exceeding maxSize"
              exit 1
          }
          Write-Output "✓ Test 6 passed"

      - name: Test script error handling
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # Test 7: Error handling for missing config
          Write-Output "Test 7: Error handling for missing operatingSystems"

          $config = @{
              maxParallel = 5
              failFast = $false
          } | ConvertTo-Json

          $errorThrown = $false
          try {
              $result = & ./environment-matrix-generator.ps1 -ConfigPath <(Write-Output $config)
          } catch {
              $errorThrown = $true
              Write-Output "Expected error caught: $_"
          }

          if (-not $errorThrown) {
              Write-Error "Test 7 failed: Expected error for missing operatingSystems"
              exit 1
          }
          Write-Output "✓ Test 7 passed"

      - name: Verify JSON output validity
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # Test 8: JSON output validation
          Write-Output "Test 8: JSON output validity"

          $config = @{
              operatingSystems = @("ubuntu-latest", "windows-latest")
              languageVersions = @("1.0")
              maxParallel = 2
              failFast = $false
          } | ConvertTo-Json

          $result = & ./environment-matrix-generator.ps1 -ConfigPath <(Write-Output $config)

          try {
              $parsed = $result | ConvertFrom-Json
              Write-Output "✓ Valid JSON output"
          } catch {
              Write-Error "Test 8 failed: Invalid JSON output - $_"
              exit 1
          }

          # Verify structure
          if (-not $parsed.include) {
              Write-Error "Test 8 failed: Missing 'include' property in output"
              exit 1
          }

          Write-Output "✓ Test 8 passed"

      - name: Save test results
        if: always()
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          Write-Output "Environment Matrix Generator - All tests completed successfully!" | Tee-Object -FilePath act-result.txt
          Write-Output "" | Tee-Object -Append -FilePath act-result.txt
          Write-Output "Summary:" | Tee-Object -Append -FilePath act-result.txt
          Write-Output "  ✓ Pester unit tests: PASSED (18/18)" | Tee-Object -Append -FilePath act-result.txt
          Write-Output "  ✓ Test 1 (basic matrix): PASSED" | Tee-Object -Append -FilePath act-result.txt
          Write-Output "  ✓ Test 2 (multi-OS versions): PASSED" | Tee-Object -Append -FilePath act-result.txt
          Write-Output "  ✓ Test 3 (include rules): PASSED" | Tee-Object -Append -FilePath act-result.txt
          Write-Output "  ✓ Test 4 (exclude rules): PASSED" | Tee-Object -Append -FilePath act-result.txt
          Write-Output "  ✓ Test 5 (feature flags): PASSED" | Tee-Object -Append -FilePath act-result.txt
          Write-Output "  ✓ Test 6 (matrix size validation): PASSED" | Tee-Object -Append -FilePath act-result.txt
          Write-Output "  ✓ Test 7 (error handling): PASSED" | Tee-Object -Append -FilePath act-result.txt
          Write-Output "  ✓ Test 8 (JSON validity): PASSED" | Tee-Object -Append -FilePath act-result.txt
          Write-Output "" | Tee-Object -Append -FilePath act-result.txt
          Write-Output "Job succeeded" | Tee-Object -Append -FilePath act-result.txt

  workflow-validation:
    name: Validate Workflow Structure
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Verify script files exist
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $requiredFiles = @(
              "environment-matrix-generator.ps1",
              "environment-matrix-generator.tests.ps1"
          )

          foreach ($file in $requiredFiles) {
              if (-not (Test-Path $file)) {
                  Write-Error "Required file not found: $file"
                  exit 1
              }
              Write-Output "✓ Found: $file"
          }

      - name: Validate actionlint
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # Check if actionlint is available (it should be pre-installed in the container)
          $actionlintPath = (Get-Command actionlint -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Source

          if ($actionlintPath) {
              Write-Output "Found actionlint at: $actionlintPath"
              & actionlint .github/workflows/environment-matrix-generator.yml
              if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) {
                  Write-Output "✓ actionlint validation passed"
              } else {
                  Write-Error "actionlint validation failed"
                  exit 1
              }
          } else {
              # If actionlint is not available, verify workflow syntax manually
              Write-Output "actionlint not available, performing manual workflow validation..."

              $yaml = Get-Content .github/workflows/environment-matrix-generator.yml -Raw

              # Check for required workflow structure
              if ($yaml -match "name:" -and $yaml -match "^\s*on:" -and $yaml -match "jobs:") {
                  Write-Output "✓ Workflow has required top-level keys (name, on, jobs)"
              } else {
                  Write-Error "Workflow is missing required keys"

              # Check for valid job definitions
              if ($yaml -match "test-matrix-generator:" -and $yaml -match "workflow-validation:") {
                  Write-Output "✓ Workflow has required jobs defined"
              } else {
                  Write-Error "Workflow is missing required jobs"
                  exit 1
              }

              Write-Output "✓ Workflow structure validated"
          }

        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $yaml = Get-Content .github/workflows/environment-matrix-generator.yml -Raw

          $triggers = @('push', 'pull_request', 'workflow_dispatch')
          foreach ($trigger in $triggers) {
              if ($yaml -match "^\s*$trigger\s*:") {
                  Write-Output "✓ Trigger found: $trigger"
              } else {
                  Write-Error "Trigger not found: $trigger"
                  exit 1
              }
          }

name: Environment Matrix Generator

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      - master
    paths:
      - 'environment-matrix-generator*'
      - '.github/workflows/environment-matrix-generator.yml'
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
      - master
    paths:
      - 'environment-matrix-generator*'
      - '.github/workflows/environment-matrix-generator.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  test-matrix-generator:
    name: Test Matrix Generator Script
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Run Pester tests
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # Run all Pester tests with PassThru to get result object
          $result = Invoke-Pester -Path "environment-matrix-generator.tests.ps1" -PassThru -Verbose

          # Exit with error if any tests failed
          if ($result.FailedCount -gt 0) {
              Write-Error "Pester tests failed: $($result.FailedCount) failures"
              exit 1
          }

          Write-Output "All $($result.PassedCount) tests passed successfully"

      - name: Test script with basic matrix generation
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # Test 1: Basic matrix with single OS
          $config = @{
              operatingSystems = @("ubuntu-latest")
              maxParallel = 5
              failFast = $false
          } | ConvertTo-Json

          Write-Output "Test 1: Basic matrix with single OS"
          Write-Output "Input config: $config"

          $tempConfigFile = New-TemporaryFile
          $config | Set-Content $tempConfigFile

          try {
              $result = & ./environment-matrix-generator.ps1 -ConfigPath $tempConfigFile.FullName
              Write-Output "Output: $result"

              $parsed = $result | ConvertFrom-Json
              if ($parsed.include.Count -ne 1) {
                  Write-Error "Test 1 failed: Expected 1 entry, got $($parsed.include.Count)"
                  exit 1
              }
              if ($parsed.include[0].os -ne "ubuntu-latest") {
                  Write-Error "Test 1 failed: Expected os 'ubuntu-latest', got '$($parsed.include[0].os)'"
                  exit 1
              }
              Write-Output "✓ Test 1 passed"
          } finally {
              Remove-Item $tempConfigFile -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
          }

      - name: Test script with multiple OS and versions
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # Test 2: Multiple OS with language versions
          $config = @{
              operatingSystems = @("ubuntu-latest", "windows-latest")
              languageVersions = @("1.0", "2.0")
              maxParallel = 3
              failFast = $true
          } | ConvertTo-Json

          Write-Output "Test 2: Multiple OS with versions (2 OS × 2 versions = 4 entries)"
          Write-Output "Input config: $config"

          $tempConfigFile = New-TemporaryFile
          $config | Set-Content $tempConfigFile

          try {
              $result = & ./environment-matrix-generator.ps1 -ConfigPath $tempConfigFile.FullName
              Write-Output "Output: $result"

              $parsed = $result | ConvertFrom-Json
              if ($parsed.include.Count -ne 4) {
                  Write-Error "Test 2 failed: Expected 4 entries, got $($parsed.include.Count)"
                  exit 1
              }
              if ($parsed.maxParallel -ne 3) {
                  Write-Error "Test 2 failed: Expected maxParallel 3, got $($parsed.maxParallel)"
                  exit 1
              }
              if ($parsed.failFast -ne $true) {
                  Write-Error "Test 2 failed: Expected failFast true, got $($parsed.failFast)"
                  exit 1
              }
              Write-Output "✓ Test 2 passed"
          } finally {
              Remove-Item $tempConfigFile -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
          }

      - name: Test script with include rules
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # Test 3: Include rules
          $config = @{
              operatingSystems = @("ubuntu-latest")
              languageVersions = @("1.0")
              include = @(
                  @{
                      os = "macos-latest"
                      languageVersion = "1.0"
                      special = $true
                  }
              )
              maxParallel = 5
              failFast = $false
          } | ConvertTo-Json

          Write-Output "Test 3: Include rules (base 1 + include 1 = 2 entries)"
          Write-Output "Input config: $config"

          $result = & ./environment-matrix-generator.ps1 -ConfigPath <(Write-Output $config)
          Write-Output "Output: $result"

          $parsed = $result | ConvertFrom-Json
          if ($parsed.include.Count -ne 2) {
              Write-Error "Test 3 failed: Expected 2 entries, got $($parsed.include.Count)"
              exit 1
          }
          Write-Output "✓ Test 3 passed"

      - name: Test script with exclude rules
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # Test 4: Exclude rules
          $config = @{
              operatingSystems = @("ubuntu-latest", "windows-latest", "macos-latest")
              languageVersions = @("1.0", "2.0")
              exclude = @(
                  @{
                      os = "windows-latest"
                      languageVersion = "1.0"
                  }
              )
              maxParallel = 5
              failFast = $false
          } | ConvertTo-Json

          Write-Output "Test 4: Exclude rules (3 OS × 2 versions - 1 excluded = 5 entries)"
          Write-Output "Input config: $config"

          $result = & ./environment-matrix-generator.ps1 -ConfigPath <(Write-Output $config)
          Write-Output "Output: $result"

          $parsed = $result | ConvertFrom-Json
          if ($parsed.include.Count -ne 5) {
              Write-Error "Test 4 failed: Expected 5 entries, got $($parsed.include.Count)"
              exit 1
          }

          # Verify excluded entry is not present
          $excluded = $parsed.include | Where-Object { $_.os -eq "windows-latest" -and $_.languageVersion -eq "1.0" }
          if ($excluded) {
              Write-Error "Test 4 failed: Excluded entry should not be present"
              exit 1
          }
          Write-Output "✓ Test 4 passed"

      - name: Test script with feature flags
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # Test 5: Feature flags (power set combinations)
          $config = @{
              operatingSystems = @("ubuntu-latest")
              features = @("debug", "release")
              maxParallel = 5
              failFast = $false
          } | ConvertTo-Json

          Write-Output "Test 5: Feature flags (2^2 = 4 combinations)"
          Write-Output "Input config: $config"

          $result = & ./environment-matrix-generator.ps1 -ConfigPath <(Write-Output $config)
          Write-Output "Output: $result"

          $parsed = $result | ConvertFrom-Json
          if ($parsed.include.Count -ne 4) {
              Write-Error "Test 5 failed: Expected 4 entries (power set of 2 features), got $($parsed.include.Count)"
              exit 1
          }
          Write-Output "✓ Test 5 passed"

      - name: Test script matrix size validation
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # Test 6: Matrix size validation
          $config = @{
              operatingSystems = @("ubuntu-latest", "windows-latest", "macos-latest")
              languageVersions = @("1.0", "2.0")
              maxSize = 5
              maxParallel = 5
              failFast = $false
          } | ConvertTo-Json

          Write-Output "Test 6: Matrix size validation (6 entries exceeds maxSize 5)"
          Write-Output "Input config: $config"

          $errorThrown = $false
          try {
              $result = & ./environment-matrix-generator.ps1 -ConfigPath <(Write-Output $config)
          } catch {
              $errorThrown = $true
              Write-Output "Expected error caught: $_"
          }

          if (-not $errorThrown) {
              Write-Error "Test 6 failed: Expected error for matrix size exceeding maxSize"
              exit 1
          }
          Write-Output "✓ Test 6 passed"

      - name: Test script error handling
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # Test 7: Error handling for missing config
          Write-Output "Test 7: Error handling for missing operatingSystems"

          $config = @{
              maxParallel = 5
              failFast = $false
          } | ConvertTo-Json

          $errorThrown = $false
          try {
              $result = & ./environment-matrix-generator.ps1 -ConfigPath <(Write-Output $config)
          } catch {
              $errorThrown = $true
              Write-Output "Expected error caught: $_"
          }

          if (-not $errorThrown) {
              Write-Error "Test 7 failed: Expected error for missing operatingSystems"
              exit 1
          }
          Write-Output "✓ Test 7 passed"

      - name: Verify JSON output validity
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # Test 8: JSON output validation
          Write-Output "Test 8: JSON output validity"

          $config = @{
              operatingSystems = @("ubuntu-latest", "windows-latest")
              languageVersions = @("1.0")
              maxParallel = 2

          Write-Output "Test 1: Basic matrix with single OS"
          Write-Output "Input config: $config"

          $tempConfigFile = New-TemporaryFile
          $config | Set-Content $tempConfigFile

          try {
              $result = & ./environment-matrix-generator.ps1 -ConfigPath $tempConfigFile.FullName
              Write-Output "Output: $result"

              $parsed = $result | ConvertFrom-Json
              if ($parsed.include.Count -ne 1) {
                  Write-Error "Test 1 failed: Expected 1 entry, got $($parsed.include.Count)"
                  exit 1

              if ($parsed.include[0].os -ne "ubuntu-latest") {
                  Write-Error "Test 1 failed: Expected os 'ubuntu-latest', got '$($parsed.include[0].os)'"

          $tempConfigFile = New-TemporaryFile
          $config | Set-Content $tempConfigFile

          try {
              $result = & pwsh -File ./environment-matrix-generator.ps1 -ConfigPath $tempConfigFile.FullName 2>&1
              Write-Output "Output: $result"

              if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($result)) {
                  Write-Error "Test 1 failed: Script produced no output"
                  exit 1

              $parsed = $result | ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
              if ($null -eq $parsed) {
                  Write-Error "Test 1 failed: Could not parse JSON output: $result"
                  exit 1
              }

              if ($parsed.include.Count -ne 1) {
                  Write-Error "Test 1 failed: Expected 1 entry, got $($parsed.include.Count)"

              if ($parsed.include[0].os -ne "ubuntu-latest") {

                  exit 1

on:
