jobs:
  test-matrix-generator:
    name: Test Matrix Generator Script
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Run Pester tests
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # Run all Pester tests with PassThru to get result object
          $result = Invoke-Pester -Path "environment-matrix-generator.tests.ps1" -PassThru -Verbose

          # Exit with error if any tests failed
          if ($result.FailedCount -gt 0) {
              Write-Error "Pester tests failed: $($result.FailedCount) failures"
              exit 1
          }

          Write-Output "All $($result.PassedCount) tests passed successfully"

      - name: Test script with basic matrix generation
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # Test 1: Basic matrix with single OS
          $config = @{
              operatingSystems = @("ubuntu-latest")
              maxParallel = 5
              failFast = $false
          } | ConvertTo-Json

          Write-Output "Test 1: Basic matrix with single OS"
          Write-Output "Input config: $config"
          Write-Output "Current directory: $(Get-Location)"
          Write-Output "Script exists: $(Test-Path ./environment-matrix-generator.ps1)"

          $tempConfigFile = New-TemporaryFile
          $config | Set-Content $tempConfigFile

          try {
              $result = & pwsh -File ./environment-matrix-generator.ps1 -ConfigPath $tempConfigFile.FullName 2>&1
              Write-Output "Output: $result"

              if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($result)) {
                  Write-Error "Test 1 failed: Script produced no output"
                  exit 1
              }

              $parsed = $result | ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
              if ($null -eq $parsed) {
                  Write-Error "Test 1 failed: Could not parse JSON output: $result"
                  exit 1
              }

              if ($parsed.include.Count -ne 1) {
                  Write-Error "Test 1 failed: Expected 1 entry, got $($parsed.include.Count)"
                  exit 1
              }
              if ($parsed.include[0].os -ne "ubuntu-latest") {
                  Write-Error "Test 1 failed: Expected os 'ubuntu-latest', got '$($parsed.include[0].os)'"
                  exit 1
              }
              Write-Output "✓ Test 1 passed"
          } catch {
              Write-Error "Test 1 failed with exception: $_"
              exit 1
          } finally {
              Remove-Item $tempConfigFile -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
          }

      - name: Test script with multiple OS and versions
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # Test 2: Multiple OS with language versions
          $config = @{
              operatingSystems = @("ubuntu-latest", "windows-latest")
              languageVersions = @("1.0", "2.0")
              maxParallel = 3
              failFast = $true
          } | ConvertTo-Json

          Write-Output "Test 2: Multiple OS with versions (2 OS × 2 versions = 4 entries)"
          Write-Output "Input config: $config"

          $tempConfigFile = New-TemporaryFile
          $config | Set-Content $tempConfigFile

          try {
              $result = & ./environment-matrix-generator.ps1 -ConfigPath $tempConfigFile.FullName
              Write-Output "Output: $result"

              $parsed = $result | ConvertFrom-Json
              if ($parsed.include.Count -ne 4) {
                  Write-Error "Test 2 failed: Expected 4 entries, got $($parsed.include.Count)"
                  exit 1
              }
              if ($parsed.maxParallel -ne 3) {
                  Write-Error "Test 2 failed: Expected maxParallel 3, got $($parsed.maxParallel)"
                  exit 1
              }
              if ($parsed.failFast -ne $true) {
                  Write-Error "Test 2 failed: Expected failFast true, got $($parsed.failFast)"
                  exit 1
              }
              Write-Output "✓ Test 2 passed"
          } finally {
              Remove-Item $tempConfigFile -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
          }

      - name: Test script with include rules
        shell: pwsh
        run: |

              languageVersions = @("1.0")

                      languageVersion = "1.0"

              Write-Output "Output: $result"

              if ($parsed.include.Count -ne 2) {
                  Write-Error "Test 3 failed: Expected 2 entries, got $($parsed.include.Count)"
                  exit 1
              }
              Write-Output "✓ Test 3 passed"
          } finally {
              Remove-Item $tempConfigFile -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
          }

      - name: Test script with exclude rules
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # Test 4: Exclude rules
          $config = @{
              operatingSystems = @("ubuntu-latest", "windows-latest", "macos-latest")
              languageVersions = @("1.0", "2.0")
              exclude = @(
                  @{
                      os = "windows-latest"
                      languageVersion = "1.0"
                  }
              )
              maxParallel = 5
              failFast = $false
          } | ConvertTo-Json

          Write-Output "Test 4: Exclude rules (3 OS × 2 versions - 1 excluded = 5 entries)"
          Write-Output "Input config: $config"

          $result = & ./environment-matrix-generator.ps1 -ConfigPath <(Write-Output $config) pwsh -File ./environment-matrix-generator.ps1 -ConfigPath $tempConfigFile.FullName
          Write-Output "Output: $result"

          $parsed = $result | ConvertFrom-Json
          if ($parsed.include.Count -ne 5) {
              Write-Error "Test 4 failed: Expected 5 entries, got $($parsed.include.Count)"
              exit 1
          }

          # Verify excluded entry is not present
          $excluded = $parsed.include | Where-Object { $_.os -eq "windows-latest" -and $_.languageVersion -eq "1.0" }
          if ($excluded) {
              Write-Error "Test 4 failed: Excluded entry should not be present"
              exit 1
          }
          Write-Output "✓ Test 4 passed"

      - name: Test script with feature flags
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # Test 5: Feature flags (power set combinations)
          $config = @{
              operatingSystems = @("ubuntu-latest")
              features = @("debug", "release")
              maxParallel = 5
              failFast = $false
          } | ConvertTo-Json

          Write-Output "Test 5: Feature flags (2^2 = 4 combinations)"
          Write-Output "Input config: $config"

          $result = & ./environment-matrix-generator.ps1 -ConfigPath <(Write-Output $config) pwsh -File ./environment-matrix-generator.ps1 -ConfigPath $tempConfigFile.FullName
          Write-Output "Output: $result"

          $parsed = $result | ConvertFrom-Json
          if ($parsed.include.Count -ne 4) {
              Write-Error "Test 5 failed: Expected 4 entries (power set of 2 features), got $($parsed.include.Count)"
              exit 1
          }
          Write-Output "✓ Test 5 passed"

      - name: Test script matrix size validation
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # Test 6: Matrix size validation
          $config = @{
              operatingSystems = @("ubuntu-latest", "windows-latest", "macos-latest")
              languageVersions = @("1.0", "2.0")
              maxSize = 5
              maxParallel = 5
              failFast = $false
          } | ConvertTo-Json

          Write-Output "Test 6: Matrix size validation (6 entries exceeds maxSize 5)"
          Write-Output "Input config: $config"

          try {
              $result = & ./environment-matrix-generator.ps1 -ConfigPath <(Write-Output $config) pwsh -File ./environment-matrix-generator.ps1 -ConfigPath $tempConfigFile.FullName

              Write-Output "Expected error caught: $_"
          }

          if (-not $errorThrown) {
              Write-Error "Test 6 failed: Expected error for matrix size exceeding maxSize"
              exit 1
          }
          Write-Output "✓ Test 6 passed"

      - name: Test script error handling
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # Test 7: Error handling for missing config
          Write-Output "Test 7: Error handling for missing operatingSystems"

          $config = @{
              maxParallel = 5
              failFast = $false
          } | ConvertTo-Json

          $errorThrown = $false
          try {
              $result = & ./environment-matrix-generator.ps1 -ConfigPath <(Write-Output $config) pwsh -File ./environment-matrix-generator.ps1 -ConfigPath $tempConfigFile.FullName
          } catch {
              $errorThrown = $true
              Write-Output "Expected error caught: $_"
          }

          if (-not $errorThrown) {
              Write-Error "Test 7 failed: Expected error for missing operatingSystems"
              exit 1
          }
          Write-Output "✓ Test 7 passed"

      - name: Verify JSON output validity
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # Test 8: JSON output validation
          Write-Output "Test 8: JSON output validity"

          $config = @{
              operatingSystems = @("ubuntu-latest", "windows-latest")
              languageVersions = @("1.0")
